text: Refinements of D-0232 and D-0245 from #369's review. The watcher marks ready only a failed draft that a writer's retry watched again, as the issue's thread shows. The core refuses any other draft, such as one a person made of the factory's pull request to stop it, and the factory labels the issue for a person. A draft that a build which passed finds open from its branch is marked ready as that build's own pull request opened ready, checked against the core. Before it marks a watched draft ready, the factory waits until GitHub says whether it can merge it, takes no step while GitHub hasn't, and reports one GitHub can't merge without marking it ready. It reads the draft's head again just before, and takes no step if the head moved. It maps each pull request onto the core as GitHub has it once it's marked ready, and one someone else closed or merged as closed or merged. A plan's failed draft whose failure was posted before failures said why is watched again, as a modeled project's is, not replaced. A run that gave no result once its step's tenure ended has its error and spend recorded beside it, as a provider's stop is, so the next step's post says why it stopped.
